reviews.title: Decent hardware
reviews.comment: Easy to install.  After installation, winding it up and getting it going went well.  Installed in an Alienware m17 R3.  Fully compatible with my laptop.  For the price, this really did the job.  Looking to get the 2TB pretty soon.
reviews.author: Rick Perez

reviews.title: Good speedy hard drive
reviews.comment: I installed this into a M4 Mac Mini dock, and have been pleasantly surprised at how fast it runs. It’s always the first of my external drives to boot up, and writing to it is as fast as writing to my internal drive. So far it’s been stable with no issues, but I’ve only had it 2 weeks.
reviews.author: Pete

reviews.title: Computer ssd #1
reviews.comment: Love the product runs well easy to put in good came quickly will definitely buy again if I ever need another.
reviews.author: timothy coons

reviews.title: I won't regret this upgrade!
reviews.comment: What a speed jump from the 1TB that was in there! Don't get me wrong I am still happy that 1TB is there too.  3 is so much better than than 1. Unless you have to take the motherboard out to get to number 3 NVMe.2. I am not a designer of these boards but on the bottom, REALLY! Not me, those two on top will be all I shall use. I am very happy with this 2TB SSD as soon all was setup it was like a new new computer. Be sure to find a socket that will run at the SSD's speed. Nice and I barely beat the the price jump too! Well worth it.
reviews.author: jb from OH
